items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: I had the Adam Brothers over there and Reuben Red Reeves.

ctx.x: Yes, because the piano player didn't show up or anything and I had to 'phone Marge up and ask her to come over and play. And her finger nails were so long, she sure did suffer that night. But she would do anything to help me you know? And they had this New Deal, they had a football game, a football team they were sponsoring you know? And boy they were the roughest young cats I ever saw in my life.

And every Friday night it was fish and chips, see, and old Charlie, Charlie was his name, ran the joint. And that was some place, believe me. (LAUGHTER). I had the Adam Brothers over there and Reuben Red Reeves.
